A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-combinedattack-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Combined Attack]] (Decipher, December 1995): The game text changes: “battle at any system,” becomes “battle,”; “one” becomes “opponent's”; “by combining the destiny draws of” becomes “present with”; “or more” becomes “(or more)”; “weapons at same system.” becomes “weapons. Add all weapon destiny draws together. Apply that total separately for each weapon.”. This is a slip: the lower part of the card set again with this text, with a black strip below with the title “Combined Attack” and a white italic “E”.

The printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
